mapper.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id WHERE wn.name_string_id = n.id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED', 'NOTIFIED'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, kind, rank, works FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.name, n.kind, n.rank, AS works, (n.name ILIKE #{prefix} ESCAPE '\') AS prefix_hit FROM name_string n WHERE n.name ILIKE #{prefix} ESCAPE '\' OR (n.name % #{q} AND similarity(n.name, #{q}) > 0.3) ) t ORDER BY prefix_hit DESC, works DESC, name, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT n.id, n.name, n.kind, n.rank, AS works FROM name_string n WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT m.usage_id, m.usage_name, m.usage_rank, m.usage_status, m.accepted_id, m.classification::text AS classification FROM name_match m JOIN xr_release r ON r.key = m.release_key AND r.current WHERE m.name_string_id = #{id} AND m.hint_key = ''

SELECT w.year AS year, count(*) AS works FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id WHERE wn.name_string_id = #{id} AND w.state IN ('INDEXED', 'NOTIFIED') AND w.year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.year ORDER BY w.year

SELECT w.id, w.title, w.publication_date FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id WHERE wn.name_string_id = #{id} AND w.state IN ('INDEXED', 'NOTIFIED') ORDER BY w.publication_date ASC NULLS LAST, w.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, works, main_subject_works FROM taxon_stats WHERE taxon_id = #{taxonId} ORDER BY year
